pages.text: The Workstation is the element exchange: it $(bold)decomposes$() unneeded high-tier materials into elements, and $(bold)synthesizes$() what you need from elements. Decomposing is for emergencies, synthesizing is for spending — both ends are usable.

$(bold)Decompose$(): turns items with elemental value (high-tier building materials, ores, and the like) back into elements. Note there is an $(bold)about 1/5 discount$() — fine for emergency element top-ups, but you won't get rich off it.$(br2)$(bold)Synthesize$(): combines elements + materials into high-tier blocks, equipment, and special items. Synthesize recipes have colony level gates; those below your level stay locked.
pages.title: Two Tabs

pages.text: $(bold)Aim your crosshair at the Workstation and right-click$() → pick a tab → pick a recipe → set the quantity → $(bold)Submit$(). Wizards work in the task queue; just watch the progress in the panel.
pages.title: Operation

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Element turnover$(): synthesizing spends elements, decomposing replenishes them — combined with $(l:wandscape:building/node_guide)Element Node$(/l) gathering, you can keep the element balance alive.$(li)When a recipe is locked, the reason is shown (level too low / elements insufficient) — just fill it in, no guessing.$(br2)$(l:wandscape:building/crafting_guide)Crafting Station (Wands)$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:building/node_guide)Element Node$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:contents/index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
